title: System Utilization Audit — 10-Pillar Synergy Pass
description: Score and remediate utilization across 10 PRISM pillars: dev tools, protocols, CLAUDE.md, skills, scripts, hooks (auto-fire), awareness, memory, container skills, AI system. Strict threshold: pillar score < 0.85 = MAJOR finding. Autopilot mode: auto-fix safe items (orphan hook re-registration, missing index regen, dead skill registration, stale CLAUDE.md counts, undocumented dispatchers); flag risky items for review. Output: SystemUtilizationAuditEngine + scored evidence files + remediation commits.
exhaustive_law_compliance: All 10 pillars enumerated; each unit produces 0-1 score + evidence file + fix list; no pillar skipped

steps.instruction: DuplicationGuard check — confirm no existing SystemUtilization* engine
Create src/engines/SystemUtilizationAuditEngine.ts with runPillar(pillarId), scorePillar, auditAll, writeReport methods
Define UtilizationScore type: { pillar, score (0-1), evidence[], gaps[], autoFixable[], reviewRequired[] }
Wire into devDispatcher as actions: util_audit_run, util_audit_pillar, util_audit_report, util_audit_fix
Add unit test src/__tests__/SystemUtilizationAuditEngine.test.ts (smoke + scoring)
build:fast and confirm zero new tsc errors
Inventory: rtk binary, vitest, esbuild, tsc, npm scripts, MCP dispatchers
Check rtk hook fires on Bash (verify H:/.claude/settings.json hook is intact)
Check build:fast / build:incremental availability and last-run timestamps
Score = (live_tools / inventoried_tools) — flag dormant/broken
Auto-fix: re-register broken hooks; report missing tools
Verify GSD_QUICK.md, DEV_PROTOCOL.md, sections/*.md fresh (<48h or current)
Verify roadmapSchema.ts + roadmap-index.json drift-free
Verify atcsDispatcher actions live; run smoke task_status
Score = protocols_documented_and_callable / total_protocols
Auto-fix: regenerate stale GSD docs; reseed roadmap-index drift
Verify all 5 CLAUDE.md files exist (root, mcp-server, engines, dispatchers, web)
Check no stale hardcoded counts (compare against PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md)
Verify shared directives reachable from CLAUDE.md links
Check AUTO-WEDM markers preserved + WEDM digest fresh
Score = (live_links + accurate_counts) / total_claims
Auto-fix: rewrite stale counts to point at PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md
Inventory all 452 skills (311 user + 141 local)
Categorize: routinely-fired vs dormant vs orphan
Cross-check trigger words in CLAUDE.md auto-suggest table — verify each command exists
Score = skills_with_clear_trigger / total_skills
Auto-fix: register undocumented skills in PRISM-COMMANDS-MANIFEST.md; suggest auto-fire rules for high-value dormant skills
Inventory 347 scripts (scripts/ + mcp-server/scripts/)
Detect last-modified vs last-invoked (git log timestamps)
Identify orphan scripts (never referenced by package.json/hooks/skills)
Score = referenced_scripts / total_scripts
Auto-fix: archive orphans into scripts/_archive/ with index
Inventory 188 .mjs hook files in .claude/hooks/
Cross-reference with 267 hook entries in H:/prism/.claude/settings.json
Detect orphans: .mjs files NOT referenced by any settings hook entry
Verify each registered hook actually fires (smoke event log)
Score = wired_AND_firing / total_mjs_hooks
Auto-fix: register orphan high-value hooks; remove dead settings entries
Verify MASTER_INDEX_COMPACT.md exists (CRITICAL — currently MISSING)
Verify ENGINE_DIGEST, DISPATCHER_DIGEST, DIRECTORY_DIGEST current
Verify BASELINE_INVENTORY + PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST in sync
Verify PRISMSelfAwarenessEngine + DuplicationGuardEngine + AISystemRouterEngine respond
Test: simulate create-engine intent, confirm hard block fires
Score = (live_indexes + functional_guards) / required_total
Auto-fix: regenerate MASTER_INDEX_COMPACT.md; rebuild any drifted digest
Verify MEMORY.md sync target (C:/Users/wompu/.claude/projects/H--prism/memory/MEMORY.md)
Verify SessionStart sync hook is registered + last fired successfully
Inventory the 34 individual memory files; classify by type (user/feedback/project/reference)
Detect stale memories (referencing dead paths C:/PRISM/, archived milestones)
Score = (live_index + recent_writes + valid_pointers) / required
Auto-fix: prune stale memories, update MEMORY.md index
Inspect docker-compose.yml services (physics-agent, batch-processor, etc.)
Verify AISystemRouterEngine routes to Docker services when applicable
Check Ollama backends listed (codellama, deepseek, etc.)
Inventory subagent types available (general-purpose, specialized)
Score = (live_routes + healthy_services) / inventoried
Auto-fix: report unhealthy services; document missing routes

units.title: Pillar 10 — PRISM AI System (the crown jewel)

steps.instruction: Inventory AI engines: PRISMSelfAwarenessEngine, PRISMCreativeReasoningEngine, ManufacturingReasoningEngine, MultiPathReasoningEngine, ExtendedThinkingBridgeEngine, DeepLearning*, Neural*, AIRoutingEngine, etc.
For each, verify exported singleton + at least one dispatcher action calling it
Verify cross-domain reasoning live (CrossDisciplinaryDeepLearningEngine.reason)
Check tribal knowledge (3,900+ tips) reachable via knowledge dispatcher
Verify chain-of-thought / opus-level engines wired into ai dispatcher
Score = (wired_AI_engines + reachable_tribal + functional_chains) / inventoried
Auto-fix: wire any orphan AI engine into appropriate dispatcher (USSH-OPUS47 pattern)

units.title: Synthesize — System Utilization Report + Remediation Plan

steps.instruction: Aggregate 10 pillar scores into composite system utilization index
Write state/shared/SYSTEM_UTILIZATION_AUDIT.md with: composite score, per-pillar breakdown, MAJOR findings list, auto-fixed items, items requiring review
Update CLAUDE.md to point at audit report
Update MEMORY.md with composite score (snapshot)
If composite < 0.85: queue follow-up milestone SYS-UTIL-AUDIT-MS1 with remediation units
Final commit: SYS-UTIL-AUDIT-MS0 closure

anti_regression: No removed hooks from settings.json without explicit replacement
No CLAUDE.md changes that break AUTO-WEDM markers
